title: OFM · Line OEE
description: OEE of a line with availability, performance and quality, where the time went, per shift, machines, stops and orders (step 3a.8b, ADR-0008).

list.name: line
list.label: Line
list.query:
-- Lines with a KPI rule (config.line_kpi_rule)
SELECT coalesce(l.display_name, l.name) AS __text, l.id AS __value
FROM config.line l
WHERE l.retired_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM config.line_kpi_rule r WHERE r.line_id = l.id)
ORDER BY l.name
list.definition:
-- Lines with a KPI rule (config.line_kpi_rule)
SELECT coalesce(l.display_name, l.name) AS __text, l.id AS __value
FROM config.line l
WHERE l.retired_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM config.line_kpi_rule r WHERE r.line_id = l.id)
ORDER BY l.name

list.name: shift
list.label: Shift
list.query:
-- All: the time picker decides. Or one shift of the last 14 days (config.line_shift),
-- newest first; its value is '<start ms>-<end ms>' (hist.fn_dashboard_period).
SELECT 'All - use the time picker' AS __text, 'all' AS __value
UNION ALL
(SELECT s.name || ' · ' || to_char(s.shift_day, 'Dy DD Mon') ||
        CASE WHEN s.ends_at > now() THEN ' (now)' ELSE '' END,
        (extract(epoch FROM s.starts_at) * 1000)::bigint || '-' || (extract(epoch FROM s.ends_at) * 1000)::bigint
 FROM config.fn_line_shifts(${line}, now() - interval '14 days', now() + interval '1 day') s
 WHERE s.starts_at <= now()
 ORDER BY s.starts_at DESC)
list.definition:
-- All: the time picker decides. Or one shift of the last 14 days (config.line_shift),
-- newest first; its value is '<start ms>-<end ms>' (hist.fn_dashboard_period).
SELECT 'All - use the time picker' AS __text, 'all' AS __value
UNION ALL
(SELECT s.name || ' · ' || to_char(s.shift_day, 'Dy DD Mon') ||
        CASE WHEN s.ends_at > now() THEN ' (now)' ELSE '' END,
        (extract(epoch FROM s.starts_at) * 1000)::bigint || '-' || (extract(epoch FROM s.ends_at) * 1000)::bigint
 FROM config.fn_line_shifts(${line}, now() - interval '14 days', now() + interval '1 day') s
 WHERE s.starts_at <= now()
 ORDER BY s.starts_at DESC)
list.description: All: the time picker decides the period. A shift: that shift, whatever the time picker says. Only used when Order is None.

list.name: order
list.label: Order
list.query:
-- None: the shift or the time picker decides. Running order: the order running now (follows to the next).
-- Or one order of the last 14 days, newest first; its value is its ID (hist.fn_dashboard_period).
SELECT 'Running order' AS __text, 'current' AS __value
UNION ALL
SELECT 'None - shift or time picker', 'none'
UNION ALL
(SELECT o.wo_number || ' · ' || o.sku || ' · ' ||
        to_char(o.started_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT s.time_zone FROM config.line l JOIN config.area a ON a.id = l.area_id
                                           JOIN config.site s ON s.id = a.site_id WHERE l.id = ${line}), 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') ||
        CASE WHEN o.completed_at IS NULL THEN ' (running)' ELSE '' END,
        o.work_order_id::text
 FROM hist.vw_work_order_interval o
 WHERE o.line_id = ${line} AND o.started_at > now() - interval '14 days'
 ORDER BY o.started_at DESC
 LIMIT 100)
list.definition:
-- None: the shift or the time picker decides. Running order: the order running now (follows to the next).
-- Or one order of the last 14 days, newest first; its value is its ID (hist.fn_dashboard_period).
SELECT 'Running order' AS __text, 'current' AS __value
UNION ALL
SELECT 'None - shift or time picker', 'none'
UNION ALL
(SELECT o.wo_number || ' · ' || o.sku || ' · ' ||
        to_char(o.started_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT s.time_zone FROM config.line l JOIN config.area a ON a.id = l.area_id
                                           JOIN config.site s ON s.id = a.site_id WHERE l.id = ${line}), 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') ||
        CASE WHEN o.completed_at IS NULL THEN ' (running)' ELSE '' END,
        o.work_order_id::text
 FROM hist.vw_work_order_interval o
 WHERE o.line_id = ${line} AND o.started_at > now() - interval '14 days'
 ORDER BY o.started_at DESC
 LIMIT 100)
list.description: Running order: the order running now, and the next one when it starts. Or an order of the last 14 days. An order wins over the shift and the time picker; None lets them decide.

panels.title: Period shown
panels.description: Which period every panel shows: the chosen order (Running order follows to the next one by itself), else the chosen shift, else the time picker. Live periods end at the last counted minute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.label AS "Period"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p

panels.title: OEE
panels.description: Fully productive time / planned production time = availability × performance × quality (ADR-0008). Red below 60 %, green from 85 %. Empty: cannot be calculated (no scheduled time, no units, or no order yet).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.oee AS "OEE"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Running time / planned production time: the share of the time meant for production the line actually ran. Red below 80 %, green from 90 %. Empty: cannot be calculated (no scheduled time, no units, or no order yet).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.availability AS "Availability"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Performance
panels.description: Units made × ideal cycle time / running time: speed against the rated speed of the product. Above 100 % means the rated speed is set too low. Red below 80 %, green from 95 %. Empty: cannot be calculated (no scheduled time, no units, or no order yet).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.performance AS "Performance"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Quality
panels.description: Good units / all units counted (good + reject). Red below 95 %, green from 99 %. Empty: cannot be calculated (no scheduled time, no units, or no order yet).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.quality AS "Quality"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Good units
panels.description: Good units at the line's output machine in scheduled time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.good AS "Good units"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

SELECT k.reject AS "Rejects"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Downtime
panels.description: Planned production time the line did not run (breakdowns, other unplanned, not accounted for).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.downtime_h AS "Downtime"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Not accounted for
panels.description: Scheduled minutes nobody has explained yet (no reason, or no data). Code stops on the line view.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.unaccounted_s / 60 AS "Not accounted for"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k

panels.title: Downtime by reason (minutes)
panels.description: Where the planned production time went, longest first, coloured by loss type. Changeover (order) = the changeover window of a work order; Minor stops = stops shorter than the line's threshold; Not accounted for = stops nobody has coded yet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.reason AS "Reason",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 9) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Breakdowns",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 12) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Other unplanned",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 90) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Not accounted for",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 6) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Changeover",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 5) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Cleaning",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 4) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Maintenance",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 7) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Other planned"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_losses(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) l
WHERE l.loss_category_id <> 2
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sum(l.seconds) DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Downtime by machine (minutes)
panels.description: The stop time each machine cost the line: the constraint's own stops, and the time it was starved or blocked by a stopped machine, charged to that machine (ADR-0024).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(l.machine, '(no data)') AS "Machine",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 9) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Breakdowns",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 12) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Other unplanned",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 90) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Not accounted for",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 6) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Changeover",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 5) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Cleaning",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 4) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Maintenance",
       round((sum(l.seconds) FILTER (WHERE l.loss_category_id = 7) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Other planned"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_losses(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) l
WHERE l.loss_category_id <> 2
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sum(l.seconds) DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: OEE trend (per hour; per day over more than 2 days)
panels.description: OEE with availability, performance and quality per hour (per day for longer periods), in Melbourne time. Gaps: hours without planned production.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.period_start AS time, s.oee AS "OEE", s.availability AS "Availability",
       s.performance AS "Performance", s.quality AS "Quality"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p,
     hist.fn_line_kpi_series(${line}, p.t0, p.t1, CASE WHEN p.t1 - p.t0 <= interval '2 days' THEN 'hour' ELSE 'day' END) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OEE by shift
panels.description: OEE of each shift with planned production in the period (shifts: Mathesar, table line_shift). Same colours as the OEE gauge.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.shift_name || ' ' || to_char(s.shift_day, 'Dy DD/MM') AS "Shift", s.oee AS "OEE"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi_by_shift(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) s
WHERE s.pos8_s > 0
ORDER BY s.starts_at

panels.title: Loss waterfall (hours)
panels.description: From calendar time down to fully productive time (ADR-0008): each red bar is a loss, each blue bar what is left. Speed, quality and fully productive time need an ideal cycle time (a work order).

targets.rawSql:
WITH k AS (SELECT k.* FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_kpi(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) k)
SELECT v.step AS "Step", round((v.base / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "base",
       round((v.total / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Time", round((v.loss / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Loss"
FROM k, LATERAL (VALUES
  (1,  '1 Calendar time',           0::float8,                                  k.pos1_s,   NULL::float8),
  (2,  '2 Not scheduled',           k.pos3_s,                                   NULL,       k.pos2_s),
  (3,  '3 Scheduled time',          0,                                          k.pos3_s,   NULL),
  (4,  '4 Maintenance',             k.pos3_s - k.pos4_s,                        NULL,       k.pos4_s),
  (5,  '5 Cleaning',                k.pos3_s - k.pos4_s - k.pos5_s,             NULL,       k.pos5_s),
  (6,  '6 Changeover',              k.pos8_s + k.pos7_s,                        NULL,       k.pos6_s),
  (7,  '7 Other planned',           k.pos8_s,                                   NULL,       k.pos7_s),
  (8,  '8 Planned production',      0,                                          k.pos8_s,   NULL),
  (9,  '9 Breakdowns',              k.pos8_s - k.pos9_s,                        NULL,       k.pos9_s),
  (10, '12 Other unplanned',        k.running_s + k.unaccounted_s,              NULL,       k.pos12_s),
  (11, 'Not accounted for',         k.running_s,                                NULL,       k.unaccounted_s),
  (12, 'Running time',              0,                                          k.running_s, NULL),
  (13, '10 Speed loss',             k.pos13_s + k.pos11_s,                      NULL,       greatest(k.pos10_s, 0)),
  (14, '11 Quality loss',           k.pos13_s,                                  NULL,       k.pos11_s),
  (15, '13 Fully productive time',  0,                                          k.pos13_s,  NULL)
) AS v (n, step, base, total, loss)
ORDER BY v.n

panels.title: Machines
panels.description: Per machine: the line stop time charged to it, its own breakdowns (stops with a breakdown reason), MTBF = running time between breakdowns, MTTR = average breakdown length.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(m.display_name, r.machine_name) AS "Machine",
       round((d.s / 60)::numeric) AS "Line stop charged (min)",
       r.breakdowns AS "Breakdowns",
       round((r.breakdown_s / 60)::numeric) AS "Breakdown (min)",
       round(r.mtbf_h::numeric, 1) AS "MTBF (h)",
       round(r.mttr_min::numeric, 1) AS "MTTR (min)",
       round((r.running_s / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Running (h)"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL hist.fn_machine_reliability(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) r
LEFT JOIN config.machine m ON m.line_id = ${line} AND m.name = r.machine_name AND m.retired_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(l.seconds) AS s FROM hist.fn_line_losses(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) l
                   WHERE l.loss_category_id <> 2 AND l.machine = coalesce(m.display_name, r.machine_name)) d ON true
ORDER BY d.s DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Stops
panels.description: Every piece of the period the line did not run, newest first: its loss, the reason (coded by the PLC, a person on the line view, or ofm), and the machine charged. Code the ones Not accounted for on the line view.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.started AS "Start", round((s.seconds / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Minutes", s.state AS "State",
       s.loss_category AS "Loss", s.reason AS "Reason", s.machine AS "Machine", s.assigned_by AS "Coded by"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_stop_list(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) s
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Work orders
panels.description: Orders that ran in the period, newest first; good, reject and OEE inside the period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.wo_number AS "Order", o.sku AS "Product", o.planned_qty AS "Planned", o.good AS "Good", o.reject AS "Reject",
       o.oee AS "OEE", o.started_at AS "Started", o.completed_at AS "Completed", o.started_by AS "Started by"
FROM hist.fn_dashboard_period(${line}, '${shift}', '${order}', $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, hist.fn_line_orders(${line}, p.t0, p.t1) o
